supersession.statement: This prospective v2 freeze narrows a future wiring smoke to 32 assignments and binds repaired current code hashes. It is not authorization to execute models and is not a scientific run.

scope.claim_boundary: Only mechanical plumbing may be assessed: checkpoint delivery/hash, state routing, typed outage, silent withholding, fresh R/N sessions, raw failures, citations, metrics, replay, and output completeness.

runtime_leakage_classifier.reason: P23_102 supplies one source group, so leave-one-source-group-out runtime state classification is not estimable. Prefix byte equality is a mechanical invariant, not a classifier PASS.

checkpoint_contract.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; json.dumps(sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=false,allow_nan=false); SHA-256 over bytes with no trailing newline; hash rendered as sha256:<64 lowercase hex>
checkpoint_contract.single_canonical_hash_rule: Every config, attestation, assignment verifier, prefix-pair row, and run manifest must use event_canonical_sha256 exactly; alternate serialization or hash is invalid.

selection.selection_rule: Freeze the first structurally valid REPAIR V+A near-local family and the first structurally valid REPAIR V+A coherent-far family by source registry rank; no answer or outcome information used.

families.question_template: What visual state transition occurs in the exact interval, and which localized non-speech audio change may distinguish it?

EXPLICIT_CHANNEL_OUTAGE.typed_error_message: The registered evidence route is currently unavailable.

far_coherence.coherence_hypothesis: The pair clears independently computed visual and audio continuity floors without using speech inventory text.

families.question_template: How might the earlier and later visual states form one chain, and which localized non-speech audio change may distinguish the two components?

EXPLICIT_CHANNEL_OUTAGE.typed_error_message: The registered evidence route is currently unavailable.

direct_long_context.reason: Excluded to keep the smoke at the 32-assignment cap; it cannot exercise staged R/N plumbing.

assignment_plan.order_rule: Exactly the listed ordinal order; no shuffle, balancing rewrite, retries appended as assignments, or post-outcome reordering.
assignment_plan.minimality: R/N is present for every family × mechanism × required-system cell. C/B is present once per family × mechanism, assigned across systems to cover endpoint plumbing without expanding to the 640-run matrix.

model_invocation_budget.definition: One provider generation request, including a repair request, counts as one invocation. Retrieval embedding/index operations are not generator invocations.
model_invocation_budget.per_assignment_rationale: At most 10 controller or generator turns under max_steps=10 plus at most one schema-repair request; single-shot RAG normally uses at most two.

abort_thresholds.rule: Stop before starting the next assignment when an immediate condition occurs or a count reaches its threshold. Preserve all completed and failed raw records; never delete or overwrite partial evidence.

non_evaluable_outputs.retention: Retain assignment, raw attempts, public trajectory, failure ledger row, citation validation row when serializable, metric-ready row with answer-quality fields null, and file inventory hashes.
non_evaluable_outputs.plumbing_denominator: included unless the run is globally invalidated by a binding or privacy failure

output_contract.metrics_contract: All 32 assignments receive a terminal metric-ready record; answer quality, competence, performance, causal, H2, Gate, and human-validity fields are absent or null.

required: all frozen hashes match before any model invocation
exact listed assignment IDs and order emitted
all 12 R/N pairs use fresh continuation sessions and byte-identical public prefixes through the canonical checkpoint
canonical checkpoint hash matches on every delivered checkpoint
silent-withholding and typed-outage surfaces are both observed in the expected mechanism-specific records
raw failures and malformed attempts are retained without substitution
citation validation runs against acquired observation IDs
all required per-assignment terminal rows and required files are present
file inventory and replay hashes close
runtime leakage classifier reported as NOT_ESTIMABLE_SINGLE_SOURCE
allowed_without_failure: empty evidence after a correctly typed blocked surface
non-evaluable outputs retained under the frozen contract

required_separate_authorizations: versioned live wiring authorization binding this exact freeze and output root
versioned redteam authorization covering private-field exposure, cache/session isolation, and outage/restoration leakage
